news.title: Mbappe ends Nike partnership to join Swiss brand On
news.lede: France's forward #10 Kylian Mbappe celebrates scoring his team's first goal during the 2026 World Cup football tournament third-place match between France and England at the Miami Stadium in Miami on July 18, 2026. PARIS - France captain Kylian Mbappe has signed with Swiss sportswear brand On, ending a long association with Nike that stretched back to the start of his career, the company announced on Friday. "Today, Swiss sportswear brand On announces its entry into football alongside football champion Kylian Mbappe, marking the beginning of the brand's journey into the world's biggest sport," read a company statement. On also announced that 1998 World Cup winner Thierry Henry had been appointed its football director.

news.title: Brazil Unveils Eight Stadiums For 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: Brazil is preparing to host the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup, with eight stadiums selected for the tournament. Eight stadiums in Brazil have been selected to host matches at the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup, with all eight venues having previously hosted games during the 2014 FIFA Men’s World Cup. The tournament will take place from June 24 to July 25, 2027, and will mark the first time the FIFA Women’s World Cup is held in South America. The selected venues are the Estádio do Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro, Estádio Nacional in Brasília, Estádio Mineirão in Belo Horizonte, Arena Castelão in Fortaleza, Estádio Beira-Rio in Porto Alegre, Arena Itaquera in São Paulo, Arena Fonte Nova in Salvador and Arena de Pernambuco in Recife, FIFA announced on Friday.

news.title: Van Bommel names first Belgium squad with eight changes from World Cup
news.lede: Belgium must do without first-choice goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who asked to be excused from the Nations League campaign. (EPA Images pic) BRUSSELS: New Belgium coach Mark van Bommel on Friday named his first squad for their four Nations League matches, retaining the core of the World Cup selection. Van Bommel, who has replaced Rudi Garcia, added eight players who did not take part in the tournament in Canada, Mexico and the US as he named a 28-man squad for matches against Italy, France (twice), and Turkey between Sept 25 and Oct 5. Belgium must do without first-choice goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who asked to be excused from the Nations League campaign to regulate his playing time.
